effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] You may delete 1 of your Digimon with [Ten Warriors] or [Hybrid] trait to delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon whose level is less than or equal to the deleted Digimon's level.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 purple level 4 or lower card with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand without paying its memory cost.
